title: Symbiosis Belt Switchback Protocol 0.1
description: Machine-readable reversibility contract for every AI capability admitted to the Centennial Jingzhang AI Symbiosis Belt. Named after the 1909 '人字形' switchback designed by Zhan Tianyou on the Jing-Zhang Railway: every forward capability must register a switchback path, and the belt must remain in a usable state after any reversal. A registered forward_state, switchback, and acceptance triple is required; unresolved items must never disappear during a handover. This schema validates structure only - it does not prove legal compliance, service availability, or on-site readiness.

protocol_version.description: Version of the Switchback Protocol this entry conforms to.

node_id.description: Spatial node this capability attaches to, e.g. K1-I01 or JZ-03. Must reference a feature id present in the submitted geometry.

scope.description: What the capability does and where, in one sentence.

inputs.description: Data and material inputs; only public, authorized, synthetic or aggregate inputs are allowed.

deployment_mode.description: sandbox_only = no production connection; pilot_limited = bounded trial area; public = available across the belt.

known_faults.description: Known limitations and failure modes registered BEFORE deployment.

no_ai_baseline.description: The non-AI equivalent service that remains available if the capability is deactivated.

rollback_path.description: Ordered steps that return the node to the previous usable state.

reversal_trigger.description: Conditions under which reversal must be initiated.

residual_traces.description: What remains after reversal (aggregate statistics, deletion of raw data, physical traces).

rollback_owner.description: The human role responsible for executing and verifying the reversal.

reproduction.description: How a third party reproduces the registered forward state from the submitted package.

decision.description: The independent incoming-party decision; unresolved items must be listed in open_items.

open_items.description: Unresolved items that remain visible; none may silently disappear in a handover.

status.description: Lifecycle state; only 'sandbox' or 'pilot' entries may be exercised.

role_ref.description: Reference to a role defined in role-spec.json, e.g. R-PUBLIC-SPACE.
